argv.description: The first or only command: its executable followed by its literal arguments.

then.description: Commands to run after argv, each only if the previous command succeeded.

cwd.description: Existing workspace-relative directory, or . for the root.

timeout_ms.description: Time limit per command in milliseconds. Defaults to 3600000 in the background or 120000 in the foreground; values below 10000 are raised to 10000.

background.description: For a requested background test, eval or watch, start a Session-owned command and return its job ID immediately. Completion notifies the conversation; do not poll in a model loop. Only rearm a bounded wait if the user's task calls for it. Jobs stay in their launch workspace and cannot be resumed after exit or reset.
